userStories.title: Skip no-story baseline capture and explain publish-only HEAD movement
userStories.description:
**Goal** — A run with no pending story leaves baseline artifacts untouched, and a publish-only HEAD-moved refusal identifies the commits responsible.

**Motivation** — A `nax run --publish-only` on a finished feature rewrote `test-baseline.json`; `runCompletionPhase` auto-committed it as `chore(<feature>): auto-commit after run-summary session`; `publishOnlyStart` then saw `prior.head !== head` and refused with `HEAD moved since the workflow finished; run nax run so the new commits are reviewed`.

**Approach** — **Skip the capture when no story is pending (`runner-execution.ts`).** The capture block in `runExecutionPhase` moves into a new file-local helper `captureRunStartBaseline(options, prd)` (kept out of `runExecutionPhase` for the same cognitive-complexity reason as `runPreRunStepsOrFail`), which keeps today's `try/catch` and:

- returns at once under `options.dryRun`, as today;
- when `pendingStoryIds(prd).length === 0`, logs one info line `Run-start test baseline skipped — no story to run` at stage `execution` with data `{ feature }` and returns without calling `captureRunBaseline`, so neither `clearStoryBaselines` nor any baseline write happens and an existing `test-baseline.json` stays byte-identical;
- otherwise calls `captureRunBaseline` with `root`, `featureId`, `config`, `workdir`, plus `packageDirs` and `packages` (see Per-package capture).

`pendingStoryIds` (`packages/nax/src/prd/index.ts:268`) is the predicate `publishOnlyRefusal` already uses: a story is pending unless `passes` is true or its status is `passed`, `failed`, `skipped`, `blocked`, `paused`, `regression-failed` or `decomposed`. A `--publish-only` run is refused while any story is pending, so every publish-only run that reaches the execution phase skips the capture. Failed stories are reset to pending during run initialisation, so a run that will retry them still captures.

**Name the commits that moved HEAD in the publish-only refusal (`workflow/publish-only.ts`, `workflow/git.ts`, `workflow/feature.ts`, `utils/git.ts`).** A new pure predicate `isNaxAutoCommitSubject(subject: string): boolean` sits beside the auto-commit writer in `packages/nax/src/utils/git.ts` and returns true exactly for subjects matching `/^chore\([^)]*\): auto-commit after .+ session$/` (the subject the writer at `git.ts:297` produces). A new `commitsSince(projectDir: string, base: string): Promise<readonly MovedCommit[] | undefined>` in `workflow/git.ts` runs `git log --format=%h%x09%s <base>..HEAD` through `_workflowDeps.git` and returns `{ sha, subject }` per line, newest first, or `undefined` on a non-zero exit. `MovedCommit` is `{ readonly sha: string; readonly subject: string }`, exported from `workflow/publish-only.ts`. `runInContext` (`feature.ts`) calls it only when `input.publishOnly === true`, `prior?.step === "done"`, `head` and `prior.head` are both non-empty, and they differ; a throw reads as `undefined`. It passes the result as the new optional third argument of `publishOnlyStart`. Only the HEAD-moved refusal's text changes; every decision is unchanged:

- `moved` is `undefined` or empty: `HEAD moved since the workflow finished; run nax run so the new commits are reviewed` (today's text).
- some commit's subject is not a nax auto-commit: `HEAD moved since the workflow finished (<list>); run nax run so the new commits are reviewed`.
- every subject is a nax auto-commit: `HEAD moved since the workflow finished, by nax auto-commits only (<list>); the recorded review, gates and items describe <prior.head>, and nax run would review the whole branch again`, followed by `; the published PR is <prior.url>` when `prior.url` is set.

`<list>` is the first five commits as `<sha> <subject>` joined by `, `, followed by `, and <k> more` when `k` commits were left out. `<prior.head>` is the recorded head as stored. The text states facts only; it prescribes no command for the all-auto-commit case. Only the run-time auto-commit subject counts as a nax auto-commit; other nax commits in the range (for example the workflow's `chore(<feature>): advisor decisions` ledger commit) take the second wording, by design.

**Scope** — In: file-local capture guard, pure subject recognition, injected git-log read, conditional workflow wiring and factual refusal messages. Out: US-004 adds `packageDirs` and `packages` to the helper's capture call after this story; US-002 owns degraded evidence; US-003 owns package command resolution and classification; US-005 owns wrapper totals. The HEAD comparison in `publishOnlyStart` and `isFinishedAtHead` is not changed to ignore nax bookkeeping commits; only the refusal text names them. Existing `test-baseline.json` auto-commits already on a branch are not rewritten or squashed.

**Interface** —
```typescript
function captureRunStartBaseline(options: RunnerExecutionOptions, prd: PRD): Promise<void>; // file-local
export function isNaxAutoCommitSubject(subject: string): boolean;
export interface MovedCommit { readonly sha: string; readonly subject: string }
export function commitsSince(projectDir: string, base: string): Promise<readonly MovedCommit[] | undefined>;
export function publishOnlyStart(prior: WorkflowFeatureRecord | null, head: string | undefined, moved?: readonly MovedCommit[]): PublishOnlyStart;
```

**Integration and tests** — Both existing AC11 tests in `packages/nax/test/unit/execution/runner-execution-capture.test.ts` pass `runExecutionPhase` a PRD whose only story is `makeStory({ id: "US-001", status: "passed" })` and expect exactly one run-baseline write; a `status: "passed"` story is not pending, so the capture is now skipped; the PRD passed to `runExecutionPhase` uses `status: "pending"` instead, and the exactly-once assertion and its root/feature arguments stay (the `runIteration` stub's returned PRD may keep `status: "passed"`). Extend existing publish-only, workflow git and feature tests using `_workflowDeps.git`; pin no lookup at matching HEAD and fallback on a throwing lookup. US-001 creates `captureRunStartBaseline`; US-004 extends it to pass `packageDirs` and `packages`.

[unit] publishOnlyStart(prior, "h2") with no third argument, prior.step: "done" and prior.head: "h1" returns a refusal whose reason equals "HEAD moved since the workflow finished; run nax run so the new commits are reviewed".

[unit] publishOnlyStart(prior, "h2", []) with prior.step: "done" and prior.head: "h1" returns a refusal whose reason equals "HEAD moved since the workflow finished; run nax run so the new commits are reviewed".
[unit] publishOnlyStart(prior, "h1", [{ sha: "abc1234", subject: "fix: x" }]) with prior.head: "h1", prior.step: "done" and prior.outcome: "ready" returns { kind: "published" }.

[integration] runWorkflowFeature with publishOnly: true, a prior record { step: "done", outcome: "ready", head: "h1" }, readHead returning "h2", and _workflowDeps.git answering the log call with one auto-commit line throws NaxError code WORKFLOW_PUBLISH_ONLY_REFUSED whose message contains "by nax auto-commits only".

[integration] runWorkflowFeature with publishOnly: true, a prior record { step: "done", outcome: "ready", head: "h1" }, readHead returning "h2", and _workflowDeps.git throwing on the log call throws NaxError code WORKFLOW_PUBLISH_ONLY_REFUSED whose message contains "HEAD moved since the workflow finished; run nax run so the new commits are reviewed".
[integration] runWorkflowFeature with publishOnly: true and a prior record whose head equals the current HEAD never calls _workflowDeps.git with a first argument of "log".
When a run reaches execution with no pending story, including a permitted --publish-only run, an existing test-baseline.json remains byte-identical.

routing.reasoning: Five existing modules need a small capture guard, a pure subject predicate and injected git-log diagnostics; existing executor/workflow seams make these deterministic changes testable without a new orchestration abstraction.

userStories.title: Persist redacted evidence for degraded run-start baselines
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] captureRunBaseline with runCommand returning { success: false, timedOut: true, output: "line1\nline2", exitCode: 124 } for command "bun run test" with options root and workdir both "/repo" writes { kind: "no-baseline", reason: "timeout" } whose evidence has command: "bun run test", cwd: ".", exitCode: 124, and outputTail: "line1\nline2".
[unit] captureRunBaseline with _captureDeps.clockMs returning 1000 then 4500 around one timed-out command writes evidence.durationMs === 3500.
[unit] captureRunBaseline with runCommand throwing Error("spawn failed") writes { kind: "no-baseline", reason: "error" } whose evidence has error: "spawn failed" and no outputTail key.

[unit] captureRunBaseline over the list ["cmd-a", "cmd-b", "cmd-c"] where cmd-a succeeds and cmd-b and cmd-c fail with no parsed failures writes reason: "unparseable" with evidence.command === "cmd-b".
[unit] captureRunBaseline with a failing command whose output is 60 lines and whose parsed output names no failures writes an evidence.outputTail of exactly the last 40 lines.

[unit] captureRunBaseline with a failing command whose output holds "sk-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa" and whose parsed output names no failures writes an evidence.outputTail that does not hold "sk-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa".
[unit] captureRunBaseline with a timed-out command whose output is empty and whose result has no exitCode writes evidence with neither an outputTail nor an exitCode key.
[unit] captureRunBaseline with runCommand throwing Error("auth failed for sk-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa") writes an evidence.error that does not hold "sk-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa".
[unit] captureRunBaseline with a timed-out command "TOKEN=sk-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa bun run test" writes an evidence.command that does not hold "sk-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa".

[unit] captureRunBaseline with an unparseable failure whose command output is non-empty logs the info entry "No run-start test baseline" with data holding reason: "unparseable", command, cwd, durationMs and outputTail.
[unit] captureRunBaseline with regressionGateEnabled returning false writes { kind: "no-baseline", reason: "gate-disabled" } with no evidence key.
[unit] captureRunBaseline with resolveTestCommands returning undefined writes { kind: "no-baseline", reason: "no-test-command" } with no evidence key.
[unit] captureRunBaseline with a green command writes a captured baseline with no evidence key.
[unit] gateOutputTail imported from @/operations/gate-output-tail over a 50-line output returns its last 40 lines.

routing.reasoning: Evidence extends existing capture deps and baseline types and reuses the existing tail/redaction helper; strict isolation is retained for credential-bearing diagnostics persisted to committed artifacts.

suggestedCriteria: captureRunBaseline reads _captureDeps.clockMs exactly twice for each attempted command, including a command whose runner throws.
captureRunBaseline whose command resolver throws before any command runs writes an error marker with no evidence key.
captureRunBaseline logs the same sanitized command evidence fields that it persists for a timed-out command.
gateOutputTail redacts a secret spanning a line's truncation boundary before producing bounded line content.

modifiedFiles.reason: the `test.each` `logs no-baseline reason` asserts `data: { reason }` exactly for every reason; the `timeout`, `unparseable` and runner-throw `error` rows run a command, so their log data now also carries `command`, `cwd` and `durationMs`; those three rows assert `data` with `expect.objectContaining({ reason })`, and the `gate-disabled` and `no-test-command` rows keep the exact `data: { reason }`.

userStories.title: Capture run-start baselines per pending story package
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Monorepo run-start capture uses each pending story package's test gate policy and command, deduplicates equivalent executions and records package coverage.

**Motivation** — In a monorepo it runs the root test command, whose workspace runner prefixes every output line with the package name, so the bun parser names no failure and any red suite becomes `unparseable`; it also measures a different command from the per-story test gate it is compared against.

**Approach** — **Per-package capture in a monorepo (`lifecycle/test-baseline-units.ts`, `test-baseline-capture.ts`, `runner-execution.ts`).** `CaptureRunBaselineOptions` gains two optional fields:

- `packageDirs?: readonly string[]` — the repo-relative package directories to capture, `"."` for the repo root.
- `packages?: Pick<PackageRegistry, "resolve">` — the run's package registry.

`captureRunStartBaseline` passes `packageDirs` = the sorted distinct values of `storyPackageDir(story) ?? "."` over the stories whose ids `pendingStoryIds(prd)` returns (the same predicate as the skip, so a story waiting on a dependency still gets its package captured), and `packages = options.runtime.packages`.

When `packageDirs` is absent, equals `["."]`, or `packages` is absent, the capture runs exactly as today (root `regressionGateEnabled(config)` check, the root command from `resolveTestCommands(config, workdir)` in `workdir`), logs exactly as today, and writes a captured baseline with no `packageDirs` field.

Otherwise each package directory is a capture unit, handled in a new module `packages/nax/src/execution/lifecycle/test-baseline-units.ts` so `test-baseline-capture.ts` stays under the 600-line cap. A new capture dep resolves one unit:

```ts
export interface CaptureUnit {
  readonly packageDir: string;                 // "." for the repo root
  readonly gateEnabled: boolean;
  readonly timeoutSeconds: number;
  readonly command?: SuiteTestCommand;         // absent when gateEnabled is false or nothing resolves
}
// _captureDeps.resolveUnit(input: { packages, root, packageDir }) => Promise<CaptureUnit>
```

Production `resolveUnit` takes `view = packages.resolve(packageDir === "." ? undefined : packageDir)`, sets `gateEnabled = regressionGateEnabled(view.config)` and `timeoutSeconds = resolveGateTimeoutSeconds(view.config)`, and when the gate is enabled sets `command` from `resolveSuiteTestCommand({ packageView: view, workdir: packageDir === "." ? root : join(root, packageDir), packageDir: packageDir === "." ? undefined : packageDir })`. The gate switch, timeout and command are therefore all read from the same package-merged config the gate reads.

A unit with `gateEnabled: false` is skipped and logged once as info `Run-start test baseline skips a package with the regression gate disabled` with data `{ packageDir }`. An enabled unit with no `command` is skipped and logged once as info `Run-start test baseline skips a package with no test command` with data `{ packageDir }`. When no unit remains, the capture writes `gate-disabled` if every unit was disabled, otherwise `no-test-command`. The remaining units are grouped by the key `JSON.stringify([command.cmdWorkdir, normalizeCommandSpec(command.testCmd)])` (`normalizeCommandSpec` from `@nathapp/nax-agent/internal`, so `"x"` and `["x"]` share a group); each group runs once, serially, in the order of its first package directory (capture time is the sum of the groups), with the largest `timeoutSeconds` of its units, and its parsed failures are recorded for every package directory in the group. The degraded rules apply per group: a timeout stops the loop and writes `timeout`; a runner throw stops it and writes `error`; a group with any non-success command whose parsed output names no failure writes `unparseable` for the whole baseline, even when another group named failures; each with the US-002 evidence of the command that caused it. A captured multi-unit baseline sets `packageDirs` to the sorted directories of the units that ran, and each entry carries `packageDir` when its unit is not `"."`.

```json
{
  "kind": "captured",
  "source": "preflight",
  "capturedAt": "2026-11-16T09:00:00.000Z",
  "baseRef": "df670f172",
  "packageDirs": ["packages/nax", "packages/nax-agent"],
  "entries": [
    { "file": "test/unit/foo.test.ts", "testName": "foo > fails", "packageDir": "packages/nax" }
  ]
}
```

**Scope** — In: helper package selection, optional capture options, production unit resolver seam, serial grouping/execution, skipped-unit logging and package-tagged artifacts using US-002 evidence and US-003 command resolution. Out: US-001's skip/refusal implementation, US-002's evidence contract/helper move, US-003's gate resolver extraction and baseline selector, US-005's totals. Monorepo capture units run serially; running them in parallel is not part of this feature. The single-package (root-only) capture path keeps `resolveTestCommands` with no detection fallback, so a repo with no configured test command still gets `no-test-command` from the capture while the gate detects one; only the per-package path uses `resolveSuiteTestCommand`. Per-story roll-forward baselines (`writeStoryBaseline`, `source: "roll-forward"`) are not written or changed. The `no-baseline` reasons and the run-level degraded semantics (any timeout or throw degrades the whole baseline) are not changed to per-package outcomes. `.nax/` config files are not edited by this feature.

**Interface** — `CaptureRunBaselineOptions.packageDirs?: readonly string[]`; `CaptureRunBaselineOptions.packages?: Pick<PackageRegistry, "resolve">`; `_captureDeps.resolveUnit(input: { packages: Pick<PackageRegistry, "resolve">; root: string; packageDir: string }): Promise<CaptureUnit>`. Use CaptureUnit verbatim above and the upstream `SuiteTestCommand`, `BaselineEvidence`, `BaselineEntry.packageDir` and captured `TestBaseline.packageDirs`.

**Integration and tests** — Existing capture tests pass no `packageDirs` and keep the root path unchanged. Create `packages/nax/test/unit/execution/lifecycle/test-baseline-units.test.ts` for per-package capture tests and production unit resolver cases. US-001 creates `captureRunStartBaseline`; US-004 extends it to pass `packageDirs` and `packages`. US-004's `runExecutionPhase` AC observes the result through `_captureDeps.resolveUnit`. US-003 creates `resolveSuiteTestCommand`; US-004's production `resolveUnit` AC pins the capture call site. Keep root logs, cleanup and fail-open error behavior intact and retain exactly-two clock reads per attempted command when sharing/refactoring the evidence loop. A package skipped for no command is absent from coverage, so its gate findings are unattributed through the upstream selector.
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] captureRunBaseline with packages supplied and packageDirs: ["packages/a", "packages/b"] calls _captureDeps.resolveUnit once with packageDir: "packages/a" and once with packageDir: "packages/b", and runs each unit's command.testCmd through _captureDeps.runCommand in its command.cmdWorkdir, passing individual strings for list entries.

[unit] captureRunBaseline with packages supplied and packageDirs: ["packages/a", "packages/b"] where packages/a's command names failure (a.test.ts, "fails") and packages/b's is green writes packageDirs: ["packages/a", "packages/b"] and entries: [{ file: "a.test.ts", testName: "fails", packageDir: "packages/a" }].

[unit] captureRunBaseline with packages supplied and packageDirs: ["packages/a", "packages/b"] where both resolve to one shared command that names one failure writes that failure once with packageDir: "packages/a" and once with packageDir: "packages/b".

[unit] captureRunBaseline with packages supplied and packageDirs: [".", "packages/a"] where both units name a failure writes the "." unit's entry with no packageDir key and the other with packageDir: "packages/a".

[unit] captureRunBaseline with packages supplied and packageDirs: ["packages/a", "packages/b"] where packages/a is enabled with a parseable command and packages/b is enabled with no command writes packageDirs: ["packages/a"] and logs one info entry "Run-start test baseline skips a package with no test command" with data { packageDir: "packages/b" }.

[unit] captureRunBaseline with packages supplied, root "/repo" and packageDirs: ["packages/a", "packages/b"] where packages/a (cmdWorkdir: "/repo/packages/a") times out writes reason: "timeout" with evidence.cwd: "packages/a" and never runs packages/b's command.

[unit] captureRunBaseline with packages supplied and packageDirs: ["packages/a", "packages/b"] whose units resolve distinct commands with timeoutSeconds 60 and 90 runs packages/a's command with 60 and packages/b's with 90.
[unit] captureRunBaseline with packages supplied and packageDirs: ["packages/a", "packages/b"] whose units share one command with timeoutSeconds 60 and 90 runs it once with 90.
[unit] captureRunBaseline with packages supplied and packageDirs: ["packages/a", "packages/b"] whose units resolve testCmd: "x" and testCmd: ["x"] in the same cmdWorkdir runs x exactly once.

[unit] captureRunBaseline with packages supplied and packageDirs: ["packages/a", "packages/b"] where packages/a's command fails naming (a.test.ts, "fails") and packages/b's command fails naming nothing writes { kind: "no-baseline", reason: "unparseable" } whose evidence.cwd is packages/b's relative cwd.

[unit] captureRunBaseline with packageDirs: ["."], packages supplied, the root gate enabled and a green configured root command writes a captured baseline with no packageDirs key and calls _captureDeps.resolveTestCommands with the options config and workdir, never _captureDeps.resolveUnit.

[unit] captureRunBaseline with packageDirs: ["packages/a", "packages/b"], no packages and the root regression gate enabled calls _captureDeps.resolveTestCommands with the options config and workdir and never calls _captureDeps.resolveUnit.

[unit] Production _captureDeps.resolveUnit with a registry whose resolve("packages/a") returns a view whose config sets execution.regressionGate.enabled: false returns a unit with packageDir: "packages/a" and gateEnabled: false with no command.

[unit] Production _captureDeps.resolveUnit with a registry whose resolve("packages/a") returns an enabled package view whose overlay declares quality.commands.test: "bun run test" and whose merged config contains that command returns command: { testCmd: "bun run test", cmdWorkdir: join(root, "packages/a"), provenance: "overlay" }.

userStories.title: Emit parseable aggregate test totals in agent mode
userStories.description:
**Goal** — The nax test wrapper emits a single parseable pass/fail total before its successful agent-mode banner.

**Motivation** — `packages/nax/scripts/run-tests.ts` in agent mode (`AGENT=1`) prints nothing from a passing phase, so the nax package's tests never appear in a parsed green summary.

**Approach** — **A parseable total from the nax test wrapper (`packages/nax/scripts/run-tests-output.ts`, `run-tests.ts`).** The output controller gains `summaryLines(): string` and `passedBanner(): string`. In agent mode, each `finish(output, false)` reads the captured stdout and stderr for the last line matching `^\s*(\d+) pass\s*$` and the last matching `^\s*(\d+) fail\s*$` (bun's own summary lines) and adds them to running totals; a phase with no pass line adds nothing. `summaryLines()` returns `` ` ${pass} pass\n ${fail} fail\n` `` when at least one phase added a count, and `""` otherwise; in verbose mode it always returns `""`. `passedBanner()` returns `` `${summaryLines()}\n[run-tests] all phases passed\n` ``, and `run-tests.ts` `main` writes `OUTPUT_CONTROLLER.passedBanner()` in place of its current literal `\n[run-tests] all phases passed\n`. A failing phase still replays its full output and exits, unchanged. `parseTestOutput(" 15 pass\n 0 fail\n")` returns `passed: 15, failed: 0` today (checked).

**Scope** — In: per-controller counters on normal agent-mode finishes, public summary/banner methods and main's banner consumption. Out: US-001's capture guard/refusals, US-002's evidence, US-003's command/baseline helpers and US-004's package capture. `parseTestOutput` and `parseBunTestOutput` are not changed to strip workspace-runner prefixes or to sum several summary lines. `packages/repo-tooling/scripts/run-workspace-tests.ts` and the root `bun run test` command are not changed; the final repo gates keep running the root command. A phase that exceeds its cap in `run-tests.ts` still yields no test names; the baseline for it stays `unparseable`, now with evidence.

**Interface** — The controller returned by `createTestOutputController` retains `stdio`, `collect`, and `finish` and gains:
```typescript
summaryLines(): string;
passedBanner(): string;
```

**Integration and tests** — Extend `packages/nax/test/unit/scripts/run-tests-output.test.ts`. The existing controller tests do not call `summaryLines` and their replay and discard assertions hold. US-005's `passedBanner()` is consumed by `run-tests.ts` `main`, a spawning entry point with no test seam; the banner's content is unit-tested, and the story review confirms from the diff that `main` writes it in place of the literal. Test stdout-only and stderr summaries, multiple passing phases, no summary, abnormal replay and verbose mode; run `parseTestOutput` against the actual returned summary rather than changing parser behavior.
acceptanceCriteria:
[unit] An agent-mode controller after finish on output whose stderr ends " 10 pass
 0 fail
" and finish on output whose stderr ends " 5 pass
 0 fail
", both with abnormal: false, returns summaryLines() === " 15 pass
 0 fail
".

[unit] parseTestOutput over the string returned by summaryLines() of an agent-mode controller that finished two passing phases whose stderr ended " 10 pass
 0 fail
" and " 5 pass
 0 fail
" returns passed: 15 and failed: 0.
[unit] An agent-mode controller after finish on output with no bun summary line and abnormal: false returns summaryLines() === "".
[unit] An agent-mode controller after finish with abnormal: true on output holding " 3 pass\n 1 fail\n" returns summaryLines() === "" and still writes the captured stdout and stderr to its targets.
[unit] A verbose-mode controller after finish with abnormal: false returns summaryLines() === "".

[unit] An agent-mode controller after finish on output whose stdout holds " 7 pass
 0 fail
" and whose stderr is empty returns summaryLines() === " 7 pass
 0 fail
".

[unit] An agent-mode controller after finish on output whose stderr ends " 7 pass
 0 fail
" with abnormal: false returns passedBanner() === " 7 pass
 0 fail

[run-tests] all phases passed
".
[unit] A verbose-mode controller returns passedBanner() === "\n[run-tests] all phases passed\n".

routing.reasoning: Small stateful extension of an existing output controller and a single banner call-site change with deterministic controller tests; no parser or process-lifecycle redesign.

suggestedCriteria: An agent-mode controller whose normally finished phase contains several bun pass/fail summaries adds only the last pass and last fail count for that phase.
An agent-mode controller whose normally finished phase has a fail line but no pass line adds no counts.
Calling summaryLines() or passedBanner() repeatedly does not change the accumulated totals.

analysis:
Existing-code enhancement closing #2937, #2938 and #2941, entirely scoped to packages/nax. Navigation: codebase-memory MCP is unavailable in this host, so findings below come from direct reads and text searches, rooted at /Users/williamkhoo/workspace/subrina-coder/projects/nax/repos/nax. No implementation or validation commands were run while drafting this PRD.

Architecture and conventions: docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md:7 indexes the mandatory conventions; its quick reference at :143 establishes 600-line source / 800-line test hard caps, small functions, injectable _deps, named constants, and typed APIs. Use Bun and bun:test, package-scoped commands, existing @test/helpers fixtures, and restore singleton deps after each test rather than introducing mock.module contamination. The root instructions require workspace-aware changes and prohibit bare bun test and bun run nax. No other packages, manifests, version pins, generated instructions or .nax configuration require changes. Dependency direction and cycles matter: packages/nax/src/operations/full-suite-gate.ts:24 explicitly avoids an execution barrel import because operations already consumes execution/new-package-setup; execution must not import the operations barrel. Both reusable operation helpers must be exact nested barrels. The verification barrel already exports test-baseline with export * (packages/nax/src/verification/index.ts:12), so additive baseline exports are naturally available.

US-001 discovery and impact: packages/nax/src/execution/runner-execution.ts:91 contains the file-local runPreRunStepsOrFail precedent for extracting complexity. runExecutionPhase updates status, bootstraps package directories and executes preRun before the current unconditional non-dry-run capture block at :219, then computes readyStories at :233. Replace only capture orchestration with captureRunStartBaseline; do not gate on getAllReadyStories because pending dependent stories must still establish package coverage. The canonical predicate is packages/nax/src/prd/index.ts:249-270: !passes and neither passed, failed, skipped, blocked, paused, regression-failed nor decomposed. Use pendingStoryIds, not a copied status filter. Preserve the fail-open capture try/catch and dry-run guard; when no pending ids exist, do not enter capture at all, including its clearStoryBaselines call. This prevents baseline-only mutations, not every possible mutation by other run phases. packages/nax/src/workflow/publish-only.ts:15-30 currently refuses absent/unfinished records or moved/unreadable HEAD before ready/draft/resume decisions; those decisions must not change. packages/nax/src/workflow/feature.ts:223-246 loads prior/head and invokes publishOnlyStart in runInContext. Collect moved commits only for publishOnly with a done prior and two nonempty unequal heads; catch lookup throws and retain today's text. Do not alter isFinishedAtHead (:214) or ordinary-run short-circuit behavior. packages/nax/src/workflow/git.ts:66 exposes readHead and :90 exposes onlyLedgerChangedSince using _workflowDeps.git; mirror that injected git seam for commitsSince, returning undefined on nonzero status. packages/nax/src/utils/git.ts:297 writes the exact runtime auto-commit subject; colocate the pure subject predicate there. Advisor-ledger subjects are different (workflow/git.ts:14) and must deliberately take the mixed/non-auto wording.

US-001 tests: packages/nax/test/unit/execution/runner-execution-capture.test.ts:62-113 has two existing AC11 fixtures that pass status passed into runExecutionPhase yet assert one write. Change the input fixtures to pending and retain root/feature and exactly-once assertions; stub-returned PRDs may remain passed. Add no-write/no-clear, skip-log, order-before-runIteration and dry-run assertions in that existing test module, restoring _captureDeps and _unifiedExecutorDeps. packages/nax/test/unit/workflow/publish-only.test.ts:16-47 covers old refusal/published/resume branches. packages/nax/test/unit/workflow/feature.test.ts:404-432 already seeds finished records for publishOnly and asserts WORKFLOW_PUBLISH_ONLY_REFUSED; extend its real runWorkflowFeature path to assert conditional log lookup and throw fallback. packages/nax/test/unit/workflow/git.test.ts exists for injected git tests. All-auto refusal must remain a refusal, mention the stored prior head and optional URL, and prescribe no retry command.

US-002 discovery and impact: packages/nax/src/execution/lifecycle/test-baseline-capture.ts:54-124 defines injectable deps and production wiring; :130 defines options; :138-151 writes and logs only reason. The outer catch at :174-190 writes an evidence-free error marker and warns on marker-write failure. Inner capture clears story baselines (:197-204), checks gate and configured command (:207-219), runs command lists serially (:238-261), aggregates parser results (:276-285), and currently degrades when aggregate non-success has zero named failures (:292). Retain legacy aggregate semantics on the root path, including continuing command lists after an ordinary failure; add per-command timing/evidence without changing whole-capture Date.now timing. Read the new clock exactly twice per attempted command, including throws. Persist redacted command/error, root-relative cwd, optional reported exitCode, and bounded output only for command-caused timeout/unparseable/runner-error markers. Outer failures and disabled/missing-command markers stay evidence-free. packages/nax/src/verification/test-baseline.ts:45-70 owns additive BaselineEntry/TestBaseline types and :99-110 persists/reads JSON atomically without schema normalization; adding optional evidence is backward compatible and requires no artifact migration. packages/nax/src/logger/index.ts:10 reexports redactSecrets from nax-agent/internal. packages/nax/src/operations/gate-output-tail.ts:3-16 already redacts before taking the last 40 lines, trims trailing blank lines and bounds line content at 500 chars with the existing ellipsis behavior. Move it, exports unchanged, to gate-output-tail/index.ts and remove the old file. Its only located source consumers are lint-check.ts:14 and typecheck-check.ts:14; their relative imports should resolve to the directory unchanged. Do not add an operations-barrel dependency.

US-002 tests and risks: packages/nax/test/unit/execution/lifecycle/test-baseline-capture.test.ts is already 770 lines and uses production resolver snapshots plus singleton dep restoration (:64-106); place new evidence tests in the specified separate file. Existing outer-error exact marker assertions at :112-130 must remain evidence-free. packages/nax/test/unit/execution/lifecycle/test-baseline-capture-logging.test.ts:88-128 has exact data { reason } assertions for all degraded rows; only command-caused timeout/unparseable/runner-error rows change to objectContaining({ reason }), while disabled/missing-command remain exact. Green capture log assertions (:43-69) remain unchanged. Redaction is a persistence trust concern because baseline JSON is committed: test command strings, thrown error strings and output independently; do not log raw evidence before sanitizing. This story uses strict three-session-tdd because it changes persistence of potentially credential-bearing diagnostics.

US-003 discovery and impact: packages/nax/src/operations/full-suite-gate.ts:154-196 resolves packageView.config, gate timeout, effective command, detection fallback and cwd. Extract only command/cwd/provenance into suite-test-command/index.ts; leave timeout and TEST_COMMAND_MISSING message/code/context in resolveGateContext, preserving its injectable seam. Configured arrays must stay lists, not shell-joined strings. The only intentional gate-visible difference is detected cmdProvenance. packages/nax/src/quality/command-resolver.ts:69-101 prioritizes review.commands.test over quality.commands.test, substitutes {{package}} and promotes scoped turbo/nx commands when packageDir is supplied; reuse rather than reimplement it. packages/nax/src/operations/gate-cwd.ts:29-53 selects detected/overlay workdir versus root repoRoot based on the particular command's raw overlay, including review.commands.test; unrelated overlays must not move cwd. The extracted module must have no execution dependency. packages/nax/src/operations/full-suite-gate.ts:253-273 resolves both story and run baselines then applies dispositions; narrow both with baselineForPackage using storyPackageDir(story) ?? '.'. packages/nax/src/verification/test-baseline.ts:190-263 implements pure classification/matching, including absent baseline => unattributed and roll-forward earlier-story behavior. Leave those functions unchanged. Add optional metadata and a pure selector before classification: metadata-free captured artifacts remain globally applicable, but metadata-bearing artifacts apply only to covered packages. A package present with zero matching entries has a real empty baseline, yielding introduced rather than unattributed. A package absent from packageDirs gets undefined, yielding unattributed. Do not modify roll-forward writers.

US-003 tests: packages/nax/test/unit/operations/quality-gate-packageview.test.ts:136-200 already verifies package config, root fallback cwd and overlay provenance. packages/nax/test/unit/operations/full-suite-gate.test.ts:322-360 covers detection/missing commands; :407 onward covers real persisted baseline labeling, parallel selection, inheritance and read failure. Extend existing gate tests without changing their public dep seams and use the new suite-test-command.test.ts and test-baseline-package.test.ts for focused helper tests. Existing metadata-free fixtures stay valid. Pin actual gate wiring as well as pure helpers, especially the identical file/test name appearing in packages a and b and an uncovered package c.

US-004 discovery and impact: packages/nax/src/runtime/packages.ts:12-53 defines PackageView (merged config, raw overlay, repoRoot) and PackageRegistry.resolve; createPackageRegistry normalizes root to the empty key (:186) and resolves cached merged views (:197 onward). Production capture units must resolve '.' as undefined and package keys otherwise. packages/nax/src/utils/path-frame.ts:140-143 normalizes root story workdir to undefined; use it both for pending capture package selection and gate labeling. The run-start checkout workdir is the capture root, not the shell cwd. Resolve units with package-merged gate switch, timeout and the US-003 shared command resolver; do not let the root gate switch suppress enabled package units. Sorted distinct pending packages include stories waiting on dependencies but exclude passed/blocked/terminal stories. Group by JSON.stringify([cmdWorkdir, normalizeCommandSpec(testCmd)]); equal arrays and string/list-of-one forms share a group, different cwd does not. Run groups serially in first-package order, command lists independently, using group-max timeout. Copy failures into every package sharing a group, omitting packageDir for root entries, and persist sorted coverage for enabled units with commands, including green units. A group's unparseable non-success outcome degrades the whole baseline even if another group named failures; timeout/throw stop remaining work. The root legacy path still uses resolveTestCommands without detection and writes no packageDirs whenever dirs are absent, root-only, or the registry is absent. The new test-baseline-units.ts keeps capture orchestration under the source cap and reuses evidence behavior from US-002 rather than dropping redaction/timing during the split. Preserve cleanup, capture ref, fail-open persistence and existing root log behavior. US-004 depends exactly on US-001, US-002 and US-003. New tests cover pure grouping/production resolveUnit plus capture and runExecutionPhase wiring through _captureDeps.resolveUnit; root capture fixtures must continue unchanged.

US-005 discovery and impact: packages/nax/scripts/run-tests-output.ts:9-13 defines the controller contract and :20-38 currently discards successful agent-mode output and replays abnormal output verbatim. Add per-controller totals only on finish(output,false), examining captured stdout and stderr for last anchored bun summary counts; phases lacking a pass count contribute nothing. Keep verbose inherited stdio and abnormal replay untouched. packages/nax/scripts/run-tests.ts:138-150 concurrently drains captured streams, computes abnormal and calls finish; :176-184 exits immediately on any failing phase and currently prints a literal success banner. Only replace that success write with passedBanner(). It is a spawning entry point, so assert banner content through controller tests and verify main's consumption by review rather than spawning the full suite in unit tests. packages/nax/test/unit/scripts/run-tests-output.test.ts:17-51 covers discard/replay/inherit behavior and can be extended without breaking those assertions. packages/nax/src/test-runners/parser.ts:57-58 shows parseBunTestOutput is a deprecated wrapper around parseTestOutput, not a separate parser to change. The wrapper must emit one aggregate summary because the existing parser reads a last summary rather than summing phases; parser behavior and workspace-runner prefix handling are excluded.

Delivery and migration: US-001, US-002, US-003 and US-005 have no story dependencies; their shared edits to baseline types must be additive. Execute US-004 after the first three integrations. Optional JSON fields maintain old artifacts and callers; no rewrite/squash of already committed baselines, no config migration and no per-story roll-forward write changes are planned. Key regression hazards are conflating pending with currently ready, clearing snapshots on no-op runs, weakening HEAD validation, classifying advisor commits as auto-commits, recording secrets or absolute cwd, exhausting clock mocks by timing non-command work, cycles from operations/runtime barrels, accidentally short-circuiting command arrays, conflating uncovered with empty green baselines, applying root gate policy to packages, and changing root-only command detection/logs. The spec's disabled-unit AC is a behavioral subset (gateEnabled false and command absent), not removal of the required timeoutSeconds from CaptureUnit. Preserve every explicit AC in its assigned story and the feature-level exclusions below.

Refine-pass adversarial audit (read the on-disk spec and re-read capture, runner, gate, baseline types and output controller): all 76 numbered spec ACs remain in acceptanceCriteria in their original stories and original ordinal positions. Failure-table audit, in table order: row 1 is US-001 AC1/2/20; row 2 is US-001 AC9/14/18; row 3 is US-001 AC15; row 4 is US-001 AC13; row 5 is US-002 AC1/2/7; row 6 is US-002 AC3/8 and US-004 AC20; row 7 is US-002 AC4/10 and US-004 AC14; row 8 is US-004 AC7; row 9 is US-004 AC6/21; row 10 is US-004 AC8/9; row 11 is US-003 AC12; row 12 is US-005 AC3.
